points.text: INDIA bloc rally at **Ramlila Maidan**: Rahul Gandhi accused CEC **Gyanesh Kumar** of 'treason' over the SIR; the BJP held a counter-rally on the **1984 riots**.
*The Hindu* found **1,000+ discrepant entries** in Bengaluru's post-SIR rolls; BJP chief **Nitin Nabin** alleged 'three crore infiltrators'.
Bihar: independent MLCs **Bansidhar Brajwasi** and **Rahul Raj** 'joined' the BJP, then said they only backed it; RJD sought disqualification under the **Tenth Schedule**.
West Bengal will give **CAA** citizenship to **2.5 lakh Matuas** by **31 Dec 2026**; only **25,000** have got it so far.
A.P. civic polls: **13 corporations** and **79 municipalities**, turnout **48.03%** (63.30% in 2021).
CJI **Surya Kant**: **65.5 lakh** cases pend in High Courts (**292** vacancies of 1,122 posts) and nearly **1 lakh** in the Supreme Court.
Amit Shah: **Chandigarh** will be India's first **drug-free** city; **93%** conviction rate in NDPS cases since the new criminal laws began on **4 Aug 2024**.
**AMU**: about **4,000** Women's College students had no vote in the students' union election, the first in **8 years**.
**EPFO** marked its **74th** Foundation Day: corpus over **₹32 lakh crore**, **8 crore+** members; Labour Minister **Mansukh Mandaviya**.
**PLFS**: unemployment fell from **6.1% (2017-18)** to **3.2% (2023-24)**, but the **Decent Work Index** only rose 0.247 → 0.302; about **90%** of workers are informal.
**GST** collections rose **23%** in October to **₹2.31 lakh crore**, the second-highest ever; April-October was up 13.2% to ₹14.77 lakh crore.
India's solar capacity grew from **2.8 GW (2014)** to **171 GW**; tariffs fell to about **₹2.15/unit**; **PM Surya Ghar** has 21 lakh of a 65-lakh target.
Power use rose **21.88%** in October to **159.76 billion units**; **Coal India** output was up 19.3%.
Commercial **LPG** rose a third time (Delhi 19-kg to **₹2,820**); **ATF** up ₹1.37 to ₹138.5/litre; domestic LPG unchanged.
**FPIs** pulled **₹34,843 crore** out of Indian equities in October, a second straight month of outflows.
Comex **gold** fell **7.26%** to a one-year low of **$3,884.9/oz**; **silver** fell 19.1%.
**CPI inflation** edged up to **5.54%** by Sept 2026, inside the RBI's **2-6%** band.
Delhi's entry curbs on outside **below-BS-VI** vehicles began: day one saw **7,279** checks, **714** turned back, **38** impounded.
The 2026 southwest monsoon ended **13% below** the **87 cm** long-period average — the driest on record for **East and Northeast India**.
Cyclone **Murasu** was due between **Nellore and Narsapur** (120 km/h) days after **Arnab**, which cost **₹4,600 crore** and flooded 3.5 lakh ha.
Delhi plans a **3.3-km heritage corridor** on **Netaji Subhash Marg** (Delhi Gate to Kashmere Gate) past the **Red Fort**.
Bhutan dedicated **Chorten No. 76** of its **108 stupas**, built by **40,000+ volunteers**, to **PM Narendra Modi** at **Gelephu Mindfulness City**.
The **UNGA** resolution against the **US embargo on Cuba** (annual since **1992**) passed **130-17** with 18 abstentions; **India voted in favour**.
China's **CPC Fifth Plenum** expelled **33** Central Committee members, including **16 PLA generals**, before the 21st Party Congress in 2027.
Iran warned a renewed war with the US 'could last longer'; the IRGC said it would have 'no geographic limitations'.
**Lula** won a **fourth** term, beating **Flavio Bolsonaro** **51.79% to 48.21%**.
Pakistan told the Afghan **Taliban** that 'terrorism is a red line'.
Ahead of the **3 Nov midterms**, the US DOJ pressed county officials for voter data; Harvard's **ElectIt** model gave Democrats **230 of 435** House seats.

The **Defence Acquisition Council** cleared **Project 18A**: **₹80,000 crore** for **next-generation guided-missile destroyers**, about **75% indigenous**, designed by the Navy's **Warship Design Bureau**.
New IAF chief **Ashutosh Dixit** set out the '**VAYU**' framework (Vigilance, Aatmanirbharta, Yukti, Unity) and the motto *Nabha Sparsham Deeptam*.
ACM **Ashutosh Dixit** became the **29th Chief of the Air Staff** on **31 Oct**, succeeding **A.P. Singh**.
**Mahadev Online Book** promoter **Sourabh Chandrakar** (₹6,000-crore betting scam) was extradited from **Oman** after an Interpol notice.
Azam Khan went to **14-day judicial custody** in an ED **PMLA** case over farmers' land in Rampur taken for **Mohammad Ali Jauhar University**.
After **NVS-03**, the 2027-28 Budget gave the **Department of Space ₹17,000 crore** (up from ₹13,705.6 crore).
**Binance** lost over **$6.3 billion** in a 29 October hack; **Chainalysis** blamed North Korea's **Lazarus Group**.
Three arrests, including a Sub-Inspector, over an alleged rape **inside a police station** in **Seraikela**, Jharkhand; an SIT was formed.
**Jadavpur University** ordered a probe into a molestation complaint by a first-year student.
West Bengal notified **Group D jobs** for a family member of each person killed in political violence over 25 years.
**31 October** 2026 was **Sardar Patel's 151st** birth anniversary (**National Unity Day**); he integrated about **500 princely states**.
**Indian Navy** beat **BPCL** 5-4 on penalties to win the **97th MCC-Murugappa Gold Cup** hockey title.
**P.V. Sindhu** and **Lakshya Sen** won the **Hylo Open Super 500** singles titles at Saarbrücken.
**Glenn Phillips** set the record for most runs in a bilateral T20I series: **341**, past Phil Salt's 331.
New Zealand won the fifth T20I, but **India took the series 3-2** — **Shreyas Iyer's** first series win in a **SENA** country.
India's men and women won the inaugural **Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship** at **Ahmedabad**.
**Carlos Alcaraz** won the **Vienna Open**, his fourth title of the year.
**Marc Marquez** neared an **eighth MotoGP title** after winning the Malaysian GP.
**Manav Thakkar** won his first international singles title at **WTT Feeder Chennai**.
